en.joke: My therapist told me to set boundaries. So now I only check work emails from my bed on weekends.
en.explanation: Funny because it's a deadpan, self-aware take on failed work-life boundaries in remote work, humorously framing a bad habit as setting boundaries.

people.name: Esha Deol
people.extract: Esha Deol is an Indian actress who works in Hindi films. The daughter of actors Dharmendra and Hema Malini, Deol made her acting debut in the romantic thriller Koi Mere Dil Se Poochhe (2002), which won her the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut.
highlights: Daughter of actors Dharmendra and Hema Malini.
Won Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut for Koi Mere Dil Se Poochhe.

people.name: Marie Antoinette
people.bio: Consort of Louis XVI from 1774 to 1792
people.extract: Marie Antoinette was the last queen consort of France before the abolition of the monarchy during the French Revolution. She served from 1774 to 1792, as the wife of King Louis XVI. Her life story and execution by beheading in 1793 made her a tragic figure in popular culture.

people.name: Danny Cipriani
people.extract: Danny Cipriani (Italian pronunciation: [tʃiˈprjaːni] is an English former professional rugby union player. He most recently played for Premiership Rugby side Bath and previously played for Gloucester, Sale Sharks and Wasps in the Premiership and Melbourne Rebels in Super Rugby. He plays fly-half and fullback. He has also played for England. Since starting in the Wasps academy in 2003, Cipriani has been capped for England 16 times.
highlights: English former professional rugby union player.
Played for Bath, Gloucester, Sale Sharks, Wasps, Melbourne Rebels.
